title: Program amasung Source Code kari no?
learningObjectives: Program-gi meaning adubu masagi words-ta explain touba amasung mahak computer-na execute touba instructions-gi organised group-ni haiba khangba ngamgani.
Source Code-gi definition adubu explain touba amasung mahak human-na pariba Programming Language-da isingba haiba identify touba ngamgani.
Program amasung Source Code-gi relation adubu explain touba amasung ani terms adubu same meaning-da sijinnaba mistake adubu thok-hanba ngamgani.
Daily task adubu small, clear amasung order-gi instructions-da divide touba ngamgani.
Simple example amada Input, Processing amasung Output-gi role adubu explain touba ngamgani.
Ordinary language-da isingba instructions amasung Programming Language-gi rules matung inba Source Code-gi difference adubu hairiba ngamgani.
Language matung inna Compiler, Interpreter nattraga Runtime-na Source Code execute touba-da karamna help touba adubu explain touba ngamgani.
Small Code example amada instructions-gi order identify touba amasung each instruction-gi work adubu hairiba ngamgani.
Syntax amasung clarity-gi importance adubu khangba amasung unclear instructions-na wrong result karamna piribano adubu explain touba ngamgani.
Problem amagi maramda required instructions choose touba amasung expected result adubu hairiba ngamgani.
Program adubu small steps-da explain, test amasung improve touba-gi benefit adubu identify touba ngamgani.
Variables, Conditions, Loops amasung Functions learn touba-gi basic understanding adubu develop touba ngamgani.

understand.concept: Program haibadi instructions-gi organised group amani, madu computer-na task amabu complete touba execute touba ngamgani. Source Code haibadi madugi instructions-gi human-na pariba amasung isingba ngamgani form-ni, madu Programming Language amada isingba oiri. Language-gi rules matung inna Compiler, Interpreter nattraga Runtime-gi help-na computer-na Code execute toui.
understand.whyItMatters: Masi khangba maru oina leiri, maramdi Programming learning haibadi Code isingba khaktani nattana, problem amabu computer-na follow touba instructions-da transform touba su oiri. Variables, Conditions, Loops amasung Functions learn touba matamda asi foundation oina help tougani.
understand.analogy: Cooking recipe amabu think tou. Maduda required ingredients amasung steps adu order-da isingba oiri. Madugumna Program-da computer-gi instructions leiri. Instructions adu Programming Language-da isingba matamda Source Code oirak-i.
understand.analogyLimit: यो उदाहरण केवल बुझाउनका लागि हो। कम्प्युटरले सामान्य मानव भाषाको अस्पष्टता आफैँ बुझ्दैन; Programming Language का नियम आवश्यक हुन्छन्।

explain.narrative:
Program haibadi instructions-gi organised group amani, madu computer-na task amabu complete touba execute touba ngamgani. Source Code haibadi madugi instructions-gi human-na pariba amasung isingba ngamgani form-ni, madu Programming Language amada isingba oiri. Language-gi rules matung inna Compiler, Interpreter nattraga Runtime-gi help-na computer-na Code execute toui.

Masi khangba maru oina leiri, maramdi Programming learning haibadi Code isingba khaktani nattana, problem amabu computer-na follow touba instructions-da transform touba su oiri. Variables, Conditions, Loops amasung Functions learn touba matamda asi foundation oina help tougani.

Computer-na ordinary human language-gi ambiguity adubu mahakna guess touda khangde. Programming Language-gi rules adu precise oiri. Maram aduna instructions adu correct Syntax amasung clear order-da isingba darkar oiri.

examples.explanation: Computer-na ordinary human language-gi ambiguity adubu mahakna guess touda khangde. Programming Language-gi rules adu precise oiri. Maram aduna instructions adu correct Syntax amasung clear order-da isingba darkar oiri.

practise.guidedTask: Computer-na ordinary human language-gi ambiguity adubu mahakna guess touda khangde. Programming Language-gi rules adu precise oiri. Maram aduna instructions adu correct Syntax amasung clear order-da isingba darkar oiri.
practise.independentTask: Create a simple task plan. Identify its Input, Processing and Output. Then explain how the instructions would be written in a Programming Language to become Source Code.
hints: समस्यालाई साना र स्पष्ट चरणमा विभाजन गर्नुहोस्।
हरेक चरणमा के गर्नुपर्ने हो स्पष्ट लेख्नुहोस्।
सामान्य भाषाको योजना र Programming Language मा लेखिएको Source Code एउटै होइन।
